Q961.reason: Crossing the center line is excused negligence per se when a sudden emergency not of the driver's making makes compliance impossible despite reasonable care; last clear chance and strict liability do not apply.

Q901.reason: The manufacturer knowingly let the franchisee display its logo on the truck and literature, supporting apparent agency even though the installer was not an employee and the materials were nondefective.

Q983.reason: Graves disease causes restrictive ophthalmoplegia from thyroid eye disease; it is more common in women, produces a diffuse goitre, and Derbyshire neck was endemic iodine-deficiency goitre.
